"""Approve this machine's probe id with synthetic limits, then run report-check in local mode.

Exit 1 when report-check reports RULE, 2 when it cannot run, 0 otherwise.
"""

import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from omp_guardrails.test_evidence.budgets import probe_machine

RULE = sys.argv[1]
RUNTIME = "python 3.13.7"
profile_path = Path(".omp/test-profile.md")
_, front, body = profile_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("---\n", 2)
profile = json.loads(front)
profile["fast_tier_budget"] = {
    "machines": [
        {
            "id": probe_machine(RUNTIME).id,
            "platform": "canary",
            "runtime": RUNTIME,
            "wall_limit_s": 10,
            "per_test_limit_s": 1,
            "approval": "synthetic canary limits",
        }
    ]
}
profile_path.write_text("---\n" + json.dumps(profile) + "\n---\n" + body, encoding="utf-8")
command = [
    sys.executable, "-m", "omp_guardrails.cli", "report-check", "--junit", "t1-junit.xml",
    "--tier", "t1", "--mode", "local", "--revision", "canary-revision",
]
result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, check=False)
print(result.stdout + result.stderr)
if result.returncode >= 2:
    sys.exit(2)
sys.exit(1 if f": {RULE}: " in result.stdout else 0)
